spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.desc: Hurl a mote of fire — 1d10 fire damage at range. Ignites anything flammable it touches.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.desc: A beam of blue-white cold — 1d8 cold damage and the target's speed drops until your next turn.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.desc: Radiance descends on a creature — 1d8 radiant damage, and cover offers no protection.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.desc: A crackling beam of otherworldly force — 1d10 force damage. The signature of every pact.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.desc: An insult laced with enchantment — 1d4 psychic damage and disadvantage on their next attack. Words hurt.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.desc: A flame in your palm: light when you need it, a thrown 1d8 fire attack when you don't.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.desc: Touch a willing creature — they add 1d4 to one ability check. Small blessing, constant value.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.desc: A spectral hand that fetches, opens, and pockets things up to 30 feet away. The burglar's cantrip.

spells.name: Light
spells.desc: An object glows like a torch for an hour. The most underrated spell in every dungeon.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.desc: A sound or a small image, for a minute. In clever hands, worth more than fireballs.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.desc: Minor wonders: clean, flavor, warm, chill, spark, snuff. The showman's toolkit.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.desc: Three darts of force, 1d4+1 each — and they NEVER miss. The spell you cast when it must land.

spells.name: Shield
spells.desc: A reaction: +5 AC against the blow that just found you, until your next turn. Cast it after the GM says "hit".

spells.name: Sleep
spells.desc: 5d8 hit points of creatures fall unconscious, weakest first. Ends fights without a drop of blood.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.desc: Touch a creature: it regains 1d8 + your casting modifier HP. The spell friendships are made of.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.desc: A word of power at range: 1d4 + modifier HP as a bonus action. Made for picking allies up off the floor.

spells.name: Bless
spells.desc: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to every attack roll and save. Quietly one of the strongest spells there is.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.desc: A lance of light — 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack against the target has advantage.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.desc: A 3d8 sphere of the element you choose as you throw: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.desc: Grasping weeds erupt across the ground, restraining everything that fails to pull free. Control the field.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.desc: A humanoid regards you as a friendly acquaintance for an hour — or until you do something friendship wouldn't survive.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.desc: A melody only the target hears — 3d6 psychic damage and it flees from you, triggering your allies' strikes.

spells.name: Hex
spells.desc: Curse a target: your attacks against it deal +1d6, and it fumbles the ability you choose. Pairs with Eldritch Blast forever.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.desc: Spectral frost armor: 5 temporary HP, and anything that hits you in melee takes 5 cold damage back.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.desc: Mark your quarry: +1d6 damage on every hit against it, and you cannot lose its trail.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.desc: Not a spell but a promise: spend a slot when you hit to deal +2d8 radiant. Undead and fiends take +1d8 more.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.desc: A bonus action and you are 30 feet away in silver mist. The great escape, bottled.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.desc: A humanoid freezes mid-step, paralyzed. Every melee hit against them is a critical. Brutal when it lands.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.desc: Three rays of flame, 2d6 each, split between targets as you please.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.desc: A floating spectral weapon fights beside you — 1d8+modifier as a bonus action, every round, no concentration.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.desc: A bead of flame blooms into a 20-foot inferno — 8d6 fire damage, DEX save for half. The classic, for a reason.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.desc: A hundred-foot line of lightning — 8d6 lightning damage, DEX save for half. Punches through ranks.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.desc: As a reaction, strangle another caster's spell mid-word. Their circle 3 or lower simply fails.

spells.name: Fly
spells.desc: A touched creature gains a 60-foot fly speed for up to ten minutes. The ground becomes a suggestion.

spells.name: Haste
spells.desc: Double an ally's speed, +2 AC, and an extra action each turn. When it ends, they crash for a turn.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.desc: End a spell on a creature or object. Circle 3 or lower ends automatically; higher needs a check.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.desc: Within a minute of death, 300 gold worth of diamonds calls a soul back with 1 HP. The minute is everything.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.desc: Protective spirits whirl around you — enemies entering the 15-foot circle take 3d8 and slow. Walk into the fray.

spells.name: Fear
spells.desc: Project a phantasm of each viewer's worst dread — WIS save or they drop what they hold and flee.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.desc: Fey spirits arrive wearing beast shapes — a pack of wolves, a pair of great elks — and fight at your word.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.desc: A storm cloud gathers; each turn you point and 3d10 lightning answers. Outdoors in a real storm, it hits harder.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.desc: A twisting figure of light charms a whole area into staring, incapacitated, until someone shakes them.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.desc: Turn a creature into a beast — an enemy into a turtle, an ally into a giant ape. New shape, new hit points.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.desc: Step through a fold in space to anywhere within 500 feet you can visualize — walls, chasms, and cell doors notwithstanding.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.desc: CHA save or the target is thrown into a harmless demiplane. Hold it a full minute and anything extraplanar stays gone.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.desc: Raise a 60-foot curtain of roaring flame — 5d8 to anyone in or beside it. Battlefields have doors now.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.desc: Vanish utterly — and unlike the lesser spell, attacking doesn't break it. A minute of being nobody's target.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.desc: For an hour the target ignores difficult terrain, escapes any grapple, and cannot be paralyzed or restrained.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.desc: Fist-sized hail hammers a wide circle — 2d8 bludgeoning + 4d6 cold, and the ground becomes difficult terrain.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.desc: For eight hours, the first blow that would kill the warded leaves them at 1 HP instead. Buy the mistake back.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.desc: A 60-foot blast of killing frost — 8d8 cold damage, CON save for half. What it kills, it leaves as statues of ice.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.desc: Paralyze any creature — not just people. WIS save each turn to break free; melee hits against it are all crits.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.desc: A wave of healing washes over six creatures — 3d8 + your modifier to each. The whole line stands back up.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.desc: A column of divine fire falls from above — 4d6 fire + 4d6 radiant. Judgment, delivered vertically.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.desc: Move up to a thousand pounds with your mind each turn — or contest a creature's strength with your intellect.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.desc: Return a soul dead up to ten days — for 500 gold in diamonds and a body mostly intact. Death becomes negotiable.

spells.name: Insect Plague
spells.desc: A 20-foot sphere of biting locusts — 4d10 piercing, the area lightly obscured and difficult to cross.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.desc: Watch and hear a chosen creature anywhere on the same world. A possession of theirs makes the save near-hopeless.
